thread:
sarah.p: Quick sync — we need to lock final GA boundaries for SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing today. Who can take which owner?

ajay.k: I can own SLA wording + canary fallback policy. Will draft minimal SLOs.

sarah.p: Thanks. Aim for measurable things (p95 latency target, error budget, and a clear rollback trigger).

benjamin: I'll take docs + SDK examples for the SLA page. Short walkthrough and a `Troubleshooting` section.

lucy_ops: Ops can own monitoring dashboards and alerts. Need the exact metrics you'll expose. p95, p99, error-rate, queue-depth?

sarah.p: Yes — p95 latency, p99 latency, 5m error rate, dropped requests, queue length. Also need cost-per-1k-tokens estimate in pricing doc.

ajay.k: Draft SLA proposal:
```
SLA: 99.9% monthly availability for hosted inferencing endpoints (measured at request success).
Latency SLOs: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 900ms for up to 2k tokens.
Error budget: 0.1% monthly.
Failover: automatic fallback to smallest compatible variant on region outage.
```
I'll post the full text in GH PR in 30m.

benjamin: For docs, I want a compact matrix: what is covered in Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for SLAs and support response times. Also add example billing calc: `monthly_tokens * price_per_1k`.

lucy_ops: Alert routing proposal: Sev1 to oncall (pager), Sev2 email + slack, Sev3 ticketing only. Need runbook pointer and rollback playbook link.

sarah.p: Owners: SLA + rollback = ajay.k; Docs + pricing examples = benjamin; Monitoring + alerts + runbooks = lucy_ops. Ops-bot: create channels/playbooks? @ops-bot create runbook "ga-sla-rollback"

ops-bot: Created runbook: <https://internal/runbooks/ga-sla-rollback> (owner: lucy_ops).

ajay.k: Quick question: do we allow guaranteed latency for custom model pins on Dedicated? That changes SLA wording.

sarah.p: Short answer: No guarantees for arbitrary customer-managed models. We guarantee platform-hosted model variants and Dedicated capacity only when customers commit reserved pools. Add exception clause.

benjamin: Noted. I'll add a FAQ entry: "Why isn't my custom model covered?" with a bullet explanation.

lucy_ops: Monitoring: I'll add dashboards for `request_latency_ms`, `request_success_ratio`, `kv_cache_hit_rate`, `batch_size_avg`. Set alerts: p99 > 1200ms for 5m -> Sev2, error rate > 0.5% for 10m -> Sev1.

ajay.k: That alert threshold seems reasonable. I'll ensure automatic fallback triggers at the same thresholds. We're good to wire in the rollback.

sarah.p: Need one more: pricing readiness. Finance needs a statement of expected unit economics and a pricing guardrail for GA (max dev preview discount). Ben — can you provide a 1-pager with examples?

benjamin: On it. I'll include three examples (low, mid, high usage) with token math and expected monthly invoice. Drop it in the docs PR.

ops-bot: Reminder: Launch checklist item created: `GA-SLA-DOCS-MONITORING-PRICING` assigned to sarah.p, due 1745040000.

sarah.p: Thanks team. Plan: finalize PRs by EOD, sync 3pm PT to approve wording and owners. If anyone needs more time flag here. :thumbsup:

ajay.k: Will have SLA PR up by 2:15pm PT.

benjamin: Docs PR by 4pm PT (need copy review).

lucy_ops: Dashboards + runbook link by EOD.

sarah.p: Perfect. If we hit blockers, escalate to @lead-product.

benjamin: One tiny ask — can we include a short sample curl for billing export? `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/billing/export`

sarah.p: Yep, add that. Good work everyone.
